Messages.Author: Aaron
Messages.Body:
"Choose a controlled vampire; put a disease counter on him or her if
he or she does not have one. Each time a vampire with a disease
counter is in combat at close range with another vampire, the second
vampire gets a counter as well. An afflicted vampire cannot gain blood
by hunting. When an afflicted vampire untaps, he or she burns a blood,
or, if unable, loses all disease counters."

I put a disease counter on my Ezmerelda. She bums rushes Emerson
Bridges, and gives him one of her disease counters. When she freak
drives and ambushes him, can he pick up another disease counter? When
he untaps will he lose 2?
Does this only apply to the untap phase, or if Emerson happens to play
second tradition? will he also have to burn 2?

Aaron

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Aaron wrote:
>
> "Choose a controlled vampire; put a disease counter on him or her if
> he or she does not have one. Each time a vampire with a disease
> counter is in combat at close range with another vampire, the second
> vampire gets a counter as well. An afflicted vampire cannot gain blood
> by hunting. When an afflicted vampire untaps, he or she burns a blood,
> or, if unable, loses all disease counters."
>
> I put a disease counter on my Ezmerelda. She bums rushes Emerson
> Bridges, and gives him one of her disease counters. When she freak
> drives and ambushes him, can he pick up another disease counter?

Sure. But it doesn't matter.

> When
> he untaps will he lose 2?

No. An afflicted vampire only burns one blood each untap (for the disease).

> Does this only apply to the untap phase, or if Emerson happens to play
> second tradition? will he also have to burn 2?

It applies every time the vampire untaps, per card text.

Messages.Author: The Nosferatu Stuff
Messages.Body:



That particular segment of text is only relative to the playing of the card.
Obviously it is somehow possible to get more disease counters, otherwise
there would be no "lose *all* disease counters" clause. Since 'afflicted'
isn't really a state defined by the rules I was just wondering what the
effect was. I imagine if it had been worded to read "when the vampire with
this counter untaps, he or she burns a blood" that it would then be
cumulative?

Aaron
